content: Tammwayas sikaleiwag

Tasiyas Palisiy mwasanin sisiyas takatimlakeins kaleiwag mwasanin mo ilisawes Yelusalem, imekes Yeisuw, ilansa, “Aveiyag wawun muvamul isiplaves tammwayas sikaleiwag, peinan beikams kan tage nag iwidis nimes?”
Ikatimop asilivan, ilana, “Yakamiy-vak, aveiyag wawun kunuwes amikikun, mo kusiplaves Yowbad nakaleiwag?
“Yowbad nakaleiwag mamagina:

content.text: ‘Kukin kal biyeg taman o inan tonen, mo kuweiys gamag towen.’

content: “Tage yakamiy amisinap, kulansa;

content.text: ‘Aveiyag bukusekes tamam inam, bweina bukwatibom silma̱nin Yowbad, mo bukwamgwa̱yes tasiyas.’

content: “Amisinap towen waseg kugidamis Yowbad nakaleiwag.
“Tayyaweids yakamiy! Mounid palopit towen Isaya nilivnek liva̱nen yakamiy, peinan ilel Yowbad anilivan mamagina:

content.text: ‘Gamag siyas wudous waseg ivna̱seigs, tage ninous waseg isina̱leigs.
Makava itapwa̱louls waseg yey, peinan gamag mwasanin asisinap ikatimlakays, tage agusinap yey bo ipiyaves.’”

content: Mapuna Yeisuw idawes gamag babaw bimeis. Imekes Yeisuw, ilana, “Kuliganes mo bukukwakins. Aveiyag beisiw awn waseg nag biyageg gamag kululuwan, nag. Misinaka sinap towen bisap wawadon mo biyageg gamag.”
Tut wankuyeim navamul inekes Yeisuw, idibakes, ilansa, “Tabta kukwakin siyas Palisiy asimwasin amlivan to nukulivan?”

Yeisuw ikabebay, ilana, “Tamag walba̱lab nisop kay bwanabwein; tage kay tobwag nitatos. Tamag mo bigut kay siyas, bilev. Towen nakaleiwag, yakamiy nag. Tasiyas mamagina toukwaws imgwayes sisiyas toukwaws, bitokes sisiyas binawes, babaw mo bikalka̱louws bineis wa̱leg.”
Pita ilana, “Kulik kabebay towen va̱gan silawun bakakakin.”

Yeisuw ilana, “Adok yakamiy-vak igaw tatagouwaws yakamiy. Tabta kukwakins avei-kan beikoum gamag, kan towen bein watoubun, bininoun ee... igaw simwan mo bisap bein wamnat? Tage aw-sinap gamag binuway wananon, igaw mo bilivan, anilivan towen bisap wawadon mo biyageg gamag kululuwan.

“Gamag nanon waseg sinap kalbaleb, katumat gamag, subwan, kaylas, veinaw, yaweid, yagay. Sinap siyas gamag wananon bisap mo biyageg gamag towen. Tage nag biwid naman mo beikam, sinap towen nag biyageg gamag, nag.”
Vinen-Kenan inamis Yeisuw waseg
Yeisuw ilisow ven towen, inoun in walasin ven Ta̱yil o Sidon.
Na̱tan vin nag vinen-Yudiy, tage vinen-Kenan, isap, iwak, ilana, “O Guyaw, Deibid tabun yak, kusiwyoubug, peinan natug kuda̱vin yeiluw singay iyageg.”
Yeisuw gog ika̱pay, nag ikatimop anilivan, nag. Navamul mo iwekes, ilansa, “Kwayeb na̱wen iwkuwak, bo iwegweis wom.”
Yeisuw ikatimop ages, ilana, “Yowbad nikayabeig nam silma̱nin nagamag min-Yisleil, peinan mamagina sip tasiyas, ilassulis ked.”
Mana̱wen vin im, ikulul wamatan, ilana, “O Guyaw, kulabeig.”
Yeisuw ikabebay, ilana, “Awoum bakow gamagal kaeis, basekes awuk beikams, awoum.”
Iw mana̱wen vin, ilana, “E, mounid. Tage gamagal beikams, musamusan kan bikalka̱louw bininein waskawan teibol, bweina beikams mansiyas awuk puskekel, waskawan teibol nisesus.”
Yeisuw ikatimop aygan, ilana, “Vin yak, singay kunmiseig va̱gan balabeim. Mukwanitoug waseg yey avanin mo bikamat waseg yak.” Mapuna natun ibwein tut towen waseg.
Takatouns babaw ivag, mo ibweins
Yeisuw inoun, in, ivvayal yevagam avakaein yagan Galiliy, mo ikatulag in wa̱koy, isin.
Singay babaw gamag inekes sisiyas takatouns babaw, takagayals, toukwaws, tasiyas ipam kikeis o nimes, o takakons. Takatounsa babaw inawes isewas wamatan Yeisuw, ivag mo ibweins.

Gamag babaw ikines tasiyas takakons, ivag mo ilivans bwein; tasiyas ipam kikeis o nimes ivag mo idamoms; takagayals ivag mo inounas; toukwaws ivag mo ikins bwein; isom ninous, iya̱kawns waseg min-Yisleil siYowbad.
Yeisuw ivakamus kweivas tawsan tawaw

Wankuyeim Yeisuw idawes navamul, inekes, ilana, “Inok nuwag gamag babaw asimoun, kweitoun yam sigwey tasiyas nitasesus, kaeis nag beikams. Adok awoum bakayabes sona asimoun, bo bisiwsawoul wous wa̱ked.”
Iweis navamul ilansa, “Ven towen makava nawoud, avanuy bakaban kaeis tasiyas babaw gamag beikams?”
Yeisuw ikatiga̱nes, “Kweivin amibled?” Ilansa, “Kweinim kweiy son in mwanay kekel-e.”
Idibakes gamag babaw, ilana, “Kusinis.” Isinis, ikow bled towen son in, initoug, ikalin nuwan Yowbad waseg, ikikiv, issekes navamul; navamul mo ikawes ivvageins gamag babaw wasigeis.
Asibabaw ikams ikamuweips. Kan towen nikambwages isiyavis, gamwat kweinim kweiy bo ika̱lawt.
Asibabaw tasiyas ikamkwams ikamuweips kweivas tawsan tawaw sisiyas vinay gamagal babaw.
Ikous, ikayabes gamag babaw, mo itouw wa̱wag, ikala̱vis ineis ven avakaein yagan Magadan.
